answer: Pay-per-identity rent that rises with crowding: an account's weekly fee is 12 tokens times the square of live accounts sharing its device and network fingerprint cluster. A relic-poor ring of ten pays 1,200 tokens per week against 12 for one honest user, and a raven-flagged cluster pays double. Each epoch the registry recomputes clusters from signed attestations, so a tundra of clones cannot hide and anyone can verify.
